responsibility: Implements SLP (superword-level parallelism) analysis, representation, scheduling, and transformation for both basic-block vectorization and loop-aware SLP. It defines the SLP tree and instance data structures and their allocation/lifetime management, builds and frees SLP graphs, analyzes statement groups and permutations, schedules nodes including SCC/PHI cycles, generates vector statements for SLP instances, and removes or updates original scalar statements and pattern metadata after successful SLP vectorization.
